visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young adults, two women and one man, stand in a bright living room environment. The woman in the center holds a red toy boxing machine and speaks to the camera. They smile and gesture energetically, wearing casual indoor clothing. (2) The woman with reddish-brown hair prepares to flick the toy's yellow punching bag with her finger. She focuses intensely. After the strike, a digital score of 266 appears on the machine's red display. She celebrates with a fist pump. (3) The man, wearing a grey beanie and a grey sweater, takes his turn. He flicks the bag, and the display shows 247. The reddish-haired woman jumps and cheers in the background, happy with her lead. (4) The central woman in a white turtleneck dress takes her turn. She flickers the toy bag, resulting in a score of 209. The group reacts with various expressions of amusement and disappointment. (5) The reddish-haired woman, having the highest score, prepares to flick the white-clad woman's forehead as a punishment. The woman in white covers her head nervously while the other prepares her finger. (6) The reddish-haired woman flicks the forehead of the woman in white. Both immediately react with exaggerated expressions of pain and surprise. The woman in white rubs her forehead while the other holds her own finger in pain. (7) The reddish-haired woman falls onto the tiled floor in laughter and mock agony, holding her middle finger. The white-clad woman shows her forehead to the camera, which has a visible red mark. (8) The reddish-haired woman holds up a broken slipper, laughing about the absurdity of the situation. The man in the background looks on with a smile, while the camera focuses on the group's reactions.
